address: St George's Road, St. Julian's, Malta
bio: At the highest point of the island, the 33rd floor features a glazed dining room with sweeping panoramic views and a cocktail bar, while the 34th floor is home to the rooftop terrace. The menu shines the spotlight on Italian fare, with a specific section for raw ingredients and sushi. Meat lovers shouldn’t miss the wagyu ragù pappardelle, while seafood fans shouldn’t miss the grilled calamari, packed in the vibrant flavours of the Mediterranean. Definitely the place for a drink at sunset....
